claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GBR-13069 is a dopamine reuptake inhibitor with no reported cytotoxic mechanism; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect attributable to its cationic amphiphilic piperazine structure rather than to dopamine transporter inhibition.
